qualityGate.reason: The Playwright test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly. The test preserves the testCaseId in the test title and has appropriate await usage for assertions. Selectors use data-test attributes, which are generally stable. Assertions are sufficiently strong to verify navigation, page title, and visibility of important product elements. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs are present. A minor deduction is for selector specificity, since relying on product-1, product-2, product-3 without further validation of product names or counts may be brittle in larger contexts.
